I saved a draft email to Pree (psundaram@pemberline.com) and replied to June in her DM. Nothing has been sent; June has to send the draft herself.

- **What the draft says:** The subject is "Tansleigh Packaging – proposed 2027 per-seat rate" and June is cc'd. It gives the rate as $1,805 a seat, says the figure came from Tobias, and asks Pree to keep it internal.
- **Why no approval was needed:** Pree's address is a pemberline.com one, so the rule about outside mail doesn't apply. The rate is a finance figure, and June runs the deal desk, so her go-ahead is the approval it needs.
- **The rate isn't verified:** I couldn't find the $1,805 figure in any of our records, so it rests on what Tobias told June. I said this in my reply to her.
